extension.description: One-click launch OpenCode TUI in any situation: it opens as a tab in the editor area, supports custom pre-launch commands and keyboard shortcut triggers, and automatically lets OpenCode inherit the correct terminal environment.
command.launch.title: Launch OpenCode Dock
configuration.title: OpenCode Dock
configuration.command.description: The command used to launch the OpenCode TUI. For example: opencode, bunx opencode, npx @sst/opencode, or an absolute path to an executable.
configuration.preCommand.markdownDescrip: Commands executed in order before OpenCode launches, one per line; blank lines are ignored and line breaks are supported. Typical uses: `cd` into a project directory, `export` environment variables, or `source` an environment script.
configuration.terminalName.markdownDescr: The title of the terminal tab. If left empty it falls back to the default `OpenCode`. Changes only affect terminals created afterwards.
